slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize the total profit from the manufactured toys, or is there a different objective such as minimizing resource usage or meeting a specific production target?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective of the optimization and whether profit should be maximized.

slot_scores.name: boat_not_exceed_train
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about truck/train and boat/airplane linkages but never inquired about any constraint tying the number of boats to the number of trains.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no constraint linking the number of boats to the number of trains (e.g., boats cannot exceed trains).
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a boats-vs-trains relationship and its READY_TO_MODEL summary omitted any such constraint while asserting all formulation-critical facts were confirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved via a direct question; the only unresolved slot is the P2 boat/train constraint, which does not block a well-defined model.

summary: The agent confirmed the missing objective (P0) and clarified the truck/train and boat/airplane logical constraints, but never probed the P2 boats-vs-trains constraint and silently omitted it. Stopping was appropriate since only a minor P2 boundary detail remained unaddressed.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
